en: A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a large, low, symmetrical pavilion-like building with two tall corner towers topped by domes and thin spires. The structure has extensive windows, a flat roof with railings, and a central entrance reached by a short staircase with a fountain basin in front. Simple garden furniture and benches sit on the gravel and lawn in the foreground, while tall coniferous trees form a backdrop behind the building.
